system.description: This 50'-long, thin, strong rope will climb in any direction upon the command of the owner. It can fasten itself to any protruding surface and will support up to 10,000 cn of weight.
system.unidentifiedDesc: A light thin, yet incredibly sturdy, climbing rope that can support up to three fully loaded humans, approximately 7,500 coins in total weight. It can be tied to an iron spike for climbing steep surfaces or used to tie up prisoners and pull open doors.
